purpose: Provide an exact, non-automatic rollback target for any future Dashboard 3.0 regression after the G07 baseline lock.

lineage_only_not_approved_rollback.reason: It predates the verified G03-G06A security/runtime acceptance chain and must not be treated as an equivalent safe state.

rollback_sequence: Freeze further Dashboard 3.0 mutation and identify the concrete regression.
Verify the approved Git commit, launcher blob and AppDeploy v11 snapshot still resolve exactly.
If runtime drifted, restore AppDeploy version 1787752423174 only under explicit rollback authorization.
If public source drifted, restore the public launcher state represented by Git commit b7d46b80a72772ebc16bc557500eb63916a1d63c under explicit rollback authorization.
Wait for the corresponding GitHub Pages deployment to reach terminal SUCCESS.
Perform independent public read-back of the normal production URL and a hostile query/hash URL.
Require ACCESS_DENIED fail-closed for anonymous access, runtime preflight PASS 9/9 and Security negatives PASS.
If any exact identity or security check fails, stop and reopen the recovery gate; do not declare rollback accepted.
